# FileUpload { #anylumino.FileUpload }

```python
FileUpload(
    accept='',
    multiple=False,
    disabled=False,
    description='Upload',
    icon='Upload',
    icon_src='',
    icon_size='s',
    variant='',
    **kwargs,
)
```

File upload control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                                        | Default    |
|-------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| accept      | optional | Accepted file extensions or MIME types.                                                                            | `''`       |
| multiple    | optional | Whether multiple files can be selected.                                                                            | `False`    |
| disabled    | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                                                              | `False`    |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                                                                                     | `'Upload'` |
| icon        | optional | Spectrum workflow icon name, for example ``'AddContent'`` or ``'HelpCircle'``.                                     | `'Upload'` |
| icon_src    | optional | Custom icon image URL or data URI for ``sp-icon``.                                                                 | `''`       |
| icon_size   | optional | Spectrum icon size such as ``'s'``, ``'m'``, ``'l'``, ``'xl'``, or ``'xxl'``.                                      | `'s'`      |
| variant     | optional | Spectrum visual variant such as ``'accent'``, ``'primary'``, ``'negative'``, ``'positive'``, or ``'informative'``. | `''`       |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
